headline: BNR Rate for Tuesday, 11 August. The Leu Depreciated Against the Euro and US Dollar
summary: The National Bank of Romania set the euro reference rate at 5.2424 lei, up 0.28 bani (0.05%). The leu depreciated against the euro and US dollar on Tuesday, 11 August.
why: The leu is Romania's national currency, and the National Bank of Romania sets its daily reference rates against major currencies. Moves in the leu affect Romanian importers, exporters and euro-denominated debt.
